gloss: eyesore; unpleasant to look at; obstructing one's view

definitions.gloss: eyesore; something unpleasant to look at; offensive to the eyes
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone whose appearance is annoying, ugly, or unwelcome in one's field of vision.

definitions.gloss: obstructing one's view; in the way of one's sight
definitions.explanation: Something that physically blocks or interferes with what one is trying to see.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目障|めざわ}りだ。
⟦{散|ち}らかった→散らかる：04357_chirakaru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目障|めざわ}りで⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The messy room is distracting and I can't concentrate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{目障|めざわ}りな⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The scenery is beautiful, but there's an unsightly utility pole standing in the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}たないで→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。{目障|めざわ}りだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: Don't stand in front of the TV. You're in the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{目障|めざわ}りな⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だった。
examples.english: She was an unwelcome presence as far as her boss was concerned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目障|めざわ}りで、⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台無|だいな}し→台無し：11805_dainashi⟧になった。
examples.english: The tall building that was erected outside the window is an eyesore and has ruined the view we used to have.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) + {障|さわ}り (hindrance, obstruction). Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective ({目障|めざわ}りな). When used about a person, it is quite rude and implies that their very presence is unwelcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目障|めざわ}りな⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: an unwelcome presence
- {目障|めざわ}りな⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: an annoying advertisement
- {目障|めざわ}りだ: it's an eyesore; it's in the way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳障|みみざわ}り→耳障り：20216_mimizawari⟧: unpleasant to the ear; grating — the auditory counterpart
- ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧: in the way; a nuisance — more general, not limited to visual annoyance
- ⟦{見苦|みぐる}しい→見苦しい：23219_migurushii⟧: unsightly; disgraceful — focuses on the ugliness or indecency of appearance
